subject: SIG & SOC2 evidence checklist + demo sync for Aurelius Financial
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@aureliusfin.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@aureliusfin.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Initial SIG / SOC2 ask for Aurelius evaluation

Hi Logan —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As we discussed, the procurement and security teams asked us to get an initial information package so they can validate controls ahead of our technical POC. Attached is Aurelius's SIG template (v2) — we filled the basic company info but left control columns for you to map.

Can you confirm:
- Whether you can supply a completed SIG control mapping + supporting evidence for the highlighted control set (Data Protection, Key Management, Change Mgmt, Access Control)
- A copy of your latest SOC 2 Type II (or bridge letter if more recent) and ISO 27001 certificate
- Typical delivery ETA for a first evidence bundle (we're on a tight calendar: procurement wants intake by May 29)

Also want to schedule a 30-min technical walk (SRE/security) to talk data flows and KMS. Open windows on our side: Tues 21 May 09:00-11:00 PT or Wed 22 May 13:00-15:00 PT.

I've looped in procurement (procurement@aureliusfin.com) and Carlos (engineering) who will own acceptance criteria.

Thanks — looking forward to the checklist.

Samantha Lee
Head of Vendor Risk | Aurelius Financial
Samantha.Lee@aureliusfin.com

Attachment: Aurelius_SIG_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@aureliusfin.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial SIG / SOC2 ask for Aurelius evaluation

Samantha — thanks for the clear list and for the calendar options. We'll get a runbook together. High level: yes, we can produce a SIG control mapping and an evidence bundle that covers the four primary control domains you called out. Proposed plan below (quick mutual action plan so everyone has the timeline):

- Today (May 14): Redwood reviews your SIG spreadsheet and marks control owners — Kimberly will own evidence collation.
- Tue May 21: Technical walk (SRE/security) — propose 09:30-10:00 PT. Kimberly + Jasmine join to take notes on evidence gaps.
- Wed May 22 by EOD: Deliver initial evidence packet (redacted) including SOC2 report, ISO cert, SIG mapping spreadsheet, architecture diagram, and retention policy excerpts.
- May 24–29: If Aurelius requests additional artifacts, we'll route through your procurement and collate final packet.

Can procurement confirm whether we should upload artifacts to the Drive link you prefer (secure folder) or use the vendor portal you mentioned? For sensitive items (KMS key attestations, encryption config), we can provide auditor contact or a secure SFTP transfer.

I'll book Tue 21 May 09:30 PT unless you tell me another time. Looping Kimberly for owners.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
log an.wright@redwoodinference.com

--
On Tue, May 14, 2029 at 09:58 Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Logan — I'll pick this up and start a mapping. Will prepare the SOC2 and ISO artifacts and a prioritized evidence index for Aurelius.
> Kimberley
> Head of Security Assurance
> Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@aureliusfin.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@aureliusfin.com>, procurement@aureliusfin.com
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial SIG / SOC2 ask for Aurelius evaluation

Logan / Kimberly — thanks. Procurement prefers artifacts uploaded to a secure Drive folder (we'll share a short-lived link). SFTP is fine for anything that shouldn't be in Drive.

We uploaded a lightly completed SIG with comments in the right-hand 'Aurelius asks' column — please map your evidence into the control owner column. Also procurement@aureliusfin.com will send a PO template; procurement is asking for a vendor W-9 and an initial quote for Dedicated capacity (estimate only) to accompany the intake.

We confirmed the technical walk for Tue 21 May 09:30 PT — Carlos and I will have engineering and risk on the call. Please send calendar invite.

Attachment: Aurelius_SIG_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx (completed sections)

Samantha

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@aureliusfin.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial SIG / SOC2 ask for Aurelius evaluation — evidence index and delivery notes

Samantha / team — good discussion this morning. Summary and what we'll deliver by EOD Wed May 22: 

1) SIG mapping spreadsheet (Redwood_SIG_Mapping_Aurelius_20290521.xlsx) — each SIG control mapped to Redwood control IDs, evidence pointers, and owner.
2) Evidence bundle (redacted where needed):
   - SOC 2 Type II report (SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2028.pdf) — auditor letter, scope, and test results.
   - ISO 27001 certificate (ISO27001_Certificate_Redwood_2027.pdf).
   - Architecture diagram showing data flows for hosted and dedicated modes (architecture-diagram.pdf).
   - KMS summary and proof of key custody (redacted KMS logs / auditor contact upon NDA).
   - Data retention policy excerpt + retention schedule (PDF snippet).
   - Change management runbook excerpt (ticketing and deployment controls).

Delivery notes / expectations:
- Sensitive artifacts (KMS logs, unredacted telemetry) will be delivered via secure SFTP after a brief DPA addendum / limited-scope NDA. If Aurelius prefers auditor liaison, we can provide contact details for our external SOC2 auditor to validate evidence.
- Some controls reference infrastructure-level telemetry that we correlate internally; for those we will provide aggregated extracts and a description of collection windows and retention.
- If your team needs raw logs for a specific control test, we can discuss a scoped, time-bound access path.

I'll upload the initial packet to the Drive link you share and notify procurement separately for the PO/W-9.

Kimberly Park
Head of Security Assurance, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Attachment stubs: Redwood_SIG_Mapping_Aurelius_20290521.xlsx, SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2028.pdf, ISO27001_Certificate_Redwood_2027.pdf, architecture-diagram.pdf

From: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@aureliusfin.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@aureliusfin.com>, procurement@aureliusfin.com
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG & SOC2 evidence checklist + demo sync for Aurelius Financial — confirmation

Kimberly / Logan — thanks for the packet and the call earlier. We received the Drive link (procurement shared it) and saw the initial mapping. A few quick items:

- We appreciate the redacted SOC2 and ISO cert. Procurement will upload the PO and W-9 by EOD Thu May 23.
- Two asks before we mark the intake complete: (1) a short note describing how Redwood handles ephemeral keys for dedicated deployments (just the lifecycle steps) and (2) a 15‑min recorded walkthrough of the architecture diagram that we can share with internal auditors. Can you provide both by May 24?
- We'll send a DocuSign DPA to the contact you give; please confirm the signatory.

If those are deliverable, procurement will accept the evidence packet and we can schedule a 60‑minute product walk with the POC team the week of May 27.

Carlos Mendes
Senior Engineering Manager, Aurelius Financial
c.mendes@aureliusfin.com

--
On Wed, May 22, 2029 at 15:58 Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Carlos — yes, we can produce both.
> 1) Ephemeral keys lifecycle note (1 page) — we'll attach and redact examples as needed.
> 2) Architecture walkthrough recording — Jasmine will do a 15-min recorded screencast and drop a link to the Drive folder by EOD tomorrow.
>
